sloka: ते तु वीर्यगुणोपेता बलैः परिवृताः स्वकैः ।युङ्क्त्वा रथान्कामगमानुद्यद्भास्वरवर्चसः ।। ७.२३.२९ ॥
transliteration: te tu vīryaguṇopetā balaiḥ parivṛtāḥ svakaiḥ ।yuṅktvā rathānkāmagamānudyadbhāsvaravarcasaḥ ।। 7.23.29 ॥

translations.english: Endowed with valorous qualities and surrounded by their own forces, they yoked their chariots, which moved at will, shining with brilliant splendor.
